verdict.rationale: A web framework can fairly be expected to publish CVEs or security advisories, so the axis applies. The pack contains no security policy, advisory page, CVE list, or disclosure process. The only security item describes built-in framework protections, which are a different capability from a disclosure track record.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review the project's public CVE/security-advisory history to judge its track record of handling and disclosing vulnerabilities
